question: Find the volume of a right circular cylinder whose curved surface area is 1012 cm² and circumference of base is 22 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
Given:

The curved surface area of right circular cylinder = 1012 cm2. 

Circumference = 22 cm

Formula Used:

Curved surface area = 2 × πrh 

where, h = heigh
